{{Quote|I warn you. The men are easy to acquire, hard to control.|Mother Talzin|<ref name="Monster" />}}
The '''Nightbrothers''' were a tribal group of [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|men]] subservient to the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. They lived in a [[Nightbrother village/Legends|village]] on the far side of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The infamous [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], apprentice to the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], was born a [[Brother/Legends|Nightbrother]]. They were all Force-sensitive.

==Description==
{{Quote|A warrior's true strength lies not in muscle, but in anger.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="BoSSotDS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Nightbrother_FDGD.png|thumb|left|200px|A Nightbrother wielding an [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaff]]]]
The Nightbrothers spent most of their lives training in [[Nightbrother village/Legends|their village]], learning to fight with [[Axe/Legends|axes]], [[Dagger/Legends|daggers]], and [[Spear/Legends|spears]], or even their [[Unarmed combat/Legends|bare hands]]. They were divided into several tribes, all of which were overseen by the same leading Brother&mdash;around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Brother [[Viscus/Legends|Viscus]] held this position.<ref name="Monster" />

The full-body [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] covering many [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] men were considered to be the traditional markings of a warrior. The facial markings were considered the equivalent of the blemishes left by the bursting of [[Blood/Legends|blood]] vessels on the faces of the [[Sister (Witches of Dathomir)|Sisters]]. Those who had proved their worth in the [[Crucible (arena)|arena of the Crucible]] were allowed to wield powerful weapons infused with [[Dathomir Magic|Nightsister magic]], and were granted cuffs and shoulder [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

Sometimes, the [[Shaman of the Nightsisters]] would select a gifted Nightbrother and empower him with dark energies. With the help of a full coven of crafters, the shaman injected the energies of the [[Spirit (Nightsisters)|Spirits]] into the Brother's bone and muscle, turning him into a warrior behemoth. Transformed Dathomirian Zabrak were a head taller, with a broad [[Breast/Legends|chest]], strong [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and a full crown of sharp horns.<ref name="BoSSotDS" /><ref name="Monster" />

In her instructional treatise known as ''[[Wild Power]]'', [[Mother (title)/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] wrote the Nightbrothers were powerful warriors but lacked the ability to balance the conflicting energies of the [[The Ones/Legends|Twin Gods]]. According to her, [[Gender/Legends|males]] were simpler and more beastlike than females.<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==History==
{{Quote|And while our Nightbrothers are kept separated, they are marked as our kin and our warriors by the tattooing on their chests and faces.|[[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]]|<ref name="BoSSotDS" />}}
[[File:Nightbrother_by_Russell_Walks.png|thumb|right|The Nightbrothers descended from Zabrak slaves]]
Decades prior to the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a small group of male [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] were brought from [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] during a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] raid. The Human Nightsisters discovered they could interbreed with those Zabraks, leading to the creation of the [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] species known as the Dathomirians. The witches isolated their new slaves to a small area of the planet where they could draw from them at whim.<ref name="EYAWtKAtNbWAtA">{{InsiderCite|122|Everything You Always Wanted to Know about the Nightsisters but Were Afraid to Ask}}</ref> While the Nightsisters had always kept "[[maleling]]s" as labor units or [[Reproduction/Legends|mating]] partners,<ref name="Infinity">''[[Star Wars: Infinity's End]]''</ref> the Shaman of the Nightsisters Talzin restricted the use of males to the Zabrak Nightbrothers after becoming the leader of all Nightsister covens. She also thought it was best to keep them separated from the Sisters.<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] was a member of the Nightbrothers before being taken by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] to be trained as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="Restraint">{{StoryCite|story=Restraint|book=Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter}}</ref> During the Clone Wars, the Nightsisters trained [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], who was Darth Maul's blood brother, to be [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' replacement as [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] apprentice.<ref name="Monster" /> Ventress saw the Nightbrothers as "adequate fighters" but felt that they were "ill-served in isolation"; it was her opinion, contrary to Mother Talzin's view, that they could learn and achieve much more "under the direct tutelage of a Nightsister."<ref name="BoSSotDS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Maul's full-body markings were originally Sith tattoos personally applied by Darth Sidious,<ref name="JvSEGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref><ref name="Marked">{{Tales|24|Marked}}</ref> but were later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into being a tradition of his tribe, the Nightbrothers, applied shortly after birth.<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
